summary.text: Jared Bauman is a Republican state representative from Kentucky House District 28 who has served since January 1, 2023, and is seeking re-election on November 3, 2026 against Democrat Almaria Baker.
He has worked as a continuous improvement manager and an automotive accounts manager.

paragraphs.text: Jared Bauman earned a B.S. in communication from the University of Louisville in 2008.
His career experience includes working as a continuous improvement manager with The Lubrizol Corporation and an automotive accounts manager with Steel Technologies.
Bauman won the District 28 seat on November 8, 2022, defeating incumbent Democrat Charles Miller, and was re-elected on November 5, 2024, defeating Almaria Baker.
In the 2025-2026 session he served on the House Banking and Insurance, House Judiciary, House Local Government and House Natural Resources and Energy committees, and was vice chair of the last.
